labels: A close crop includes both hands, the tie knot and the lower collar, retaining each fingertip's contact with the fabric while excluding the rest of the face.; 좁은 화면에 양손과 타이 매듭 및 깃 아래가 들어오고 각 손끝의 천 접촉을 보존하며 나머지 얼굴은 화면 밖에 놓인다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: A close crop includes both hands, the tie knot and the lower collar, retaining each fingertip's contact with the fabric while excluding the rest of the face.
aliases: 손과 매듭의 클로즈업
